description: This file defines a class 'BaseParserClass' in the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for reading XLSX files. It contains a static method to convert various input types to boolean values.

classes.name: BaseParserClass
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for parsing values in the XLSX reader context within PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: boolean
